<?php
add_action('init', function () {
    delete_transient('elementor_activation_redirect');
    update_option('elementor_onboarded', true);
    update_option('elementor_tracker_notice', '1');
}, 1);

add_action('admin_init', function () {
    delete_transient('elementor_activation_redirect');
    update_option('elementor_onboarded', true);

    if (!isset($_GET['page'])) {
        return;
    }

    $page = sanitize_key(wp_unslash($_GET['page']));
    if (in_array($page, array('elementor-app', 'elementor-getting-started', 'go_elementor_pro'), true)) {
        wp_safe_redirect(admin_url('admin.php?page=lsdp-get-started'));
        exit;
    }
}, 1);

<?php
add_action('plugins_loaded', function () {
    if (!function_exists('PLL')) return;

    if (!PLL()->model->get_languages_list()) {
        PLL()->model->add_language([
            'name' => 'English', 'slug' => 'en', 'locale' => 'en_US', 'rtl' => 0, 'flag_code' => 'us', 'term_group' => 0
        ]);
        PLL()->model->add_language([
            'name' => 'Français', 'slug' => 'fr', 'locale' => 'fr_FR', 'rtl' => 0, 'flag_code' => 'fr', 'term_group' => 0
        ]);
        PLL()->model->add_language([
            'name' => 'Español', 'slug' => 'es', 'locale' => 'es_ES', 'rtl' => 0, 'flag_code' => 'es', 'term_group' => 0
        ]);
        if (method_exists(PLL()->model, 'clean_languages_cache')) {
            PLL()->model->clean_languages_cache();
        }
    }

    $options = get_option('polylang', array());
    if (!is_array($options)) {
        $options = array();
    }
    $options['force_lang'] = 1;
    $options['rewrite'] = true;
    $options['hide_default'] = true;
    update_option('polylang', $options);

    update_option('pll_dismissed_notices', ['wizard']);
});

<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// 1) Pretty permalinks required for /es/hogar/ directory URLs.
update_option('permalink_structure', '/%postname%/');

// 2) Polylang directory URL mode (/es/, /fr/).
$options = get_option('polylang', array());
if (!is_array($options)) {
  $options = array();
}
$options['force_lang'] = 1;
$options['rewrite'] = true;
$options['hide_default'] = true;
update_option('polylang', $options);

// 3) Re-link translations (Playground remaps WXR post IDs).
if (function_exists('pll_set_post_language') && function_exists('pll_save_post_translations')) {
  $map = array(
    'en' => 'home',
    'fr' => 'maison',
    'es' => 'hogar',
  );

  $translations = array();
  foreach ($map as $lang => $slug) {
    $p = get_page_by_path($slug);
    if (!$p) {
      continue;
    }
    pll_set_post_language((int) $p->ID, $lang);
    $translations[$lang] = (int) $p->ID;
  }

  if (count($translations) > 1) {
    pll_save_post_translations($translations);
  }

  if (function_exists('PLL') && method_exists(PLL()->model, 'clean_languages_cache')) {
    PLL()->model->clean_languages_cache();
  }
}

// 4) Set Home as front page after languages/links are ready.
$page = get_page_by_path('home');
if ($page) {
  update_option('show_on_front', 'page');
  update_option('page_on_front', (int) $page->ID);
}

// 5) Flush rewrites so /es/hogar/ and /fr/maison/ resolve.
delete_option('rewrite_rules');
flush_rewrite_rules(false);
echo 'polylang urls ready';

<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$plugin = 'language-switcher-for-divi-polylang/language-switcher-for-divi-polylang.php';
$plugins = get_option('active_plugins', array());
if (!is_array($plugins)) {
  $plugins = array();
}
if (!in_array($plugin, $plugins, true)) {
  $plugins[] = $plugin;
  sort($plugins);
  update_option('active_plugins', $plugins);
}

<?php
add_action('admin_init', function () {
    if (!is_user_logged_in() || !current_user_can('manage_options')) {
        return;
    }

    if (!is_admin()) {
        return;
    }

    if (defined('DOING_AJAX') && DOING_AJAX) {
        return;
    }

    if (isset($_COOKIE['lsdp_dashboard_redirect_done'])) {
        return;
    }

    if (isset($_GET['page']) && $_GET['page'] === 'lsdp-get-started') {
        setcookie('lsdp_dashboard_redirect_done', '1', time() + 3600, COOKIEPATH, COOKIE_DOMAIN, is_ssl(), true);
        return;
    }

    setcookie('lsdp_dashboard_redirect_done', '1', time() + 3600, COOKIEPATH, COOKIE_DOMAIN, is_ssl(), true);
    wp_safe_redirect(admin_url('admin.php?page=lsdp-get-started'));
    exit;
});
